description: Reference ITempoProofingProvider speaking the LanguageTool v2 HTTP protocol (POST {base}/v2/check with form-encoded text + language, JSON matches response). Works against a self-hosted LanguageTool container (see docs/proofing-languagetool.md for the compose file) or any protocol-compatible endpoint; supports Czech via Language="cs-CZ". Findings whose word is in the client-side CustomDictionary are suppressed, and AddToDictionary(word) suppresses a word for subsequent checks.
